summary.value: Select component, used to display a native select.

a11y.method: drafted from the docs page, quote-verified, human-reviewed 2026-08-11 (batch 2: agent first-pass, ratified)

value.rule: Avoid disabling the select; it can be unclear to users why the field is unusable
value.quote: Avoid disabling select if you can. It may be difficult for users to understand why the field cannot be used.

value.rule: Select should always have a label
value.quote: Select should always have a label.

value.rule: If the label comes from a table header and is visually hidden, it must still make sense since screen readers will read it aloud
value.quote: If select is inside a table and gets its label from the table header, the label can be hidden. However, make sure the label still makes sense, since it will still be read aloud by screen readers.

value.rule: Avoid the disabled state; consider not showing the field, showing plain text, or using readOnly instead
value.quote: Avoid using the disabled ( disabled ) state. Consider instead whether you need to show the field at all, or whether you can present the information as plain text or use readOnly .

relations.method: drafted from the docs page, quote-verified, human-reviewed 2026-08-11 (batch 2: agent first-pass, ratified)

value.note: Use radio instead of select when there are only a few options and enough space
value.quote: Avoid select when you have only a few options and enough space — use radio instead

value.note: Recommended over select's multiple attribute when the user must select multiple options, for clarity and accessibility
value.quote: the user must select multiple options. Although HTML select supports this through the multiple attribute, it is not user-friendly, especially on mobile. We recommend checkbox or suggestion for a clearer and more accessible solution.

value.note: Recommended over select's multiple attribute when the user must select multiple options, for clarity and accessibility
value.quote: the user must select multiple options. Although HTML select supports this through the multiple attribute, it is not user-friendly, especially on mobile. We recommend checkbox or suggestion for a clearer and more accessible solution.

value.note: Radio buttons are often easier for users when there are fewer than 7 options
value.quote: For fewer options, radio buttons (radio) are often easier for users.

value.note: Use suggestion instead when the user needs to select multiple options or filter the list
value.quote: If the user needs to select multiple options or filter the list, you should consider using suggestion .

value.note: Radio buttons can be a better choice if the right preceding questions reduce the option count
value.quote: If you ask the right questions first, radio buttons (radio) can be a better choice.

value.rule: Place the label and description above the select field for visibility on small screens and to avoid error-message issues
value.quote: We place the label and description above the field to ensure good visibility on small screens and to avoid issues with error messages.
